name: KIC 3234655
description: A red-clump giant burning helium in its core in the Kepler field, 11.4 solar radii and 1.61 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 3234655 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 11.3909 +/- 0.2008

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 3234655 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.6148 +/- 0.0624

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 3234655 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4963.778 +/- 57.2926

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 3234655 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.5358 +/- 0.0043

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red-clump giant in the Kepler field, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.61 solar masses and 11.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,964 K at its surface.
